findings.current: But rising from the center of the blackened ash was Jin Taekyung—and he wasn’t alone.
findings.defect: The draft makes Jin's company the point of the sentence. The source says the screams and System alerts were not the only things awaiting him as he rose.
findings.rationale: The Lycanthrope Champion's attack is introduced as another thing awaiting Jin, not as someone rising alongside him.
findings.replacement: But the screams and System alerts weren’t all that awaited Jin Taekyung as he rose from the center of the blackened ash.
findings.source: 그러나 까맣게 물든 잿더미의 중심에서 몸을 일으키는 진태경을 기다리고 있던 것은 비단 그뿐만이 아니었다.

findings.defect: The draft addresses the Prophet directly, though Jin is asking the Manticore where the Prophet is.
findings.rationale: The Manticore has just referred to the Prophet and answers Jin's question about that person's whereabouts.

findings.current: “What the hell are you talking about? We’ll have a much better chance if we each take the strongest one we can.”
findings.defect: The draft turns a strongest-versus-strongest matchup into both allies trying to take the strongest opponent.
findings.rationale: 제일 센 놈끼리 붙어야 describes matching the strongest fighters against each other, which explains the Skeleton King's assignment.
findings.replacement: “What the hell are you talking about? We’ve got a much better chance if the strongest fight the strongest.”
findings.source: “그게 무슨 개소리냐. 제일 센 놈끼리 붙어야 훨씬 승산이 있지.”

findings.current: “He didn’t run all the way away, at least. He’s back there with the front ranks.”
findings.defect: The draft omits Jin's sarcastic suggestion that Yamamoto may have had a shred of conscience.
findings.rationale: 그나마 양심은 있었는지 is a hedged, mocking judgment of Yamamoto, not merely a description of how far he fled.
findings.replacement: “Maybe he had a shred of conscience left, because he didn’t run off entirely. He’s back there in the front ranks.”
findings.source: “그나마 양심은 있었는지, 아예 도망치진 않고 저기 뒤로 빠져 있네. 선두 대열.”

findings.current: —So it was you. The human that one spoke of.
findings.defect: “That one” loses the Manticore's deferential reference to its superior and reads unnatural in English.
findings.rationale: 그분 is a respectful reference to the unidentified figure, rendered “that person” in the supplied glossary.
findings.replacement: —So it’s you. The human that person spoke of.

findings.current: Dark crimson magical power burst through the monsters’ cries as they burned alive in the flames.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the magic's physical path between burning monsters with the nonsensical image of it bursting through their cries.
findings.rationale: 몬스터들의 사이로 locates the eruption among the monsters, immediately before its pressure extinguishes the flames.
findings.replacement: Dark crimson magical power burst from between the monsters shrieking as they burned in the flames.
findings.source: 불길 속에서 괴성을 내지르며 타들어 가는 몬스터들의 사이로 검붉은 마력이 뿜어져 나왔다.

findings.current: “It’s stronger than I expected. One of them, especially, is practically a named monster even among the S-ranks.”
findings.defect: “It’s” prematurely singles out one monster; Jin first assesses the opponents collectively, then distinguishes one of them.
findings.rationale: 그중에서도 (‘among them’) makes the first assessment apply to the group.
findings.replacement: “They’re stronger than I expected. One of them, especially, is practically a named monster even among the S-ranks.”
findings.source: “생각 이상으로 강해. 그중에서도 특히 한 놈은 S급 중에서도 네임드 수준이고.”

findings.current:

>
> [Lv. 140 Death Knight Legion Commander]
>
> [Lv. 148 Manticore Lord]
findings.defect: The game notices retain square brackets and lack the required shared System-panel heading.
findings.rationale: These three consecutive level notices form one actual game System panel under the packet's Markdown rules.
findings.replacement:

> Lv. 130 Lycanthrope Champion
> Lv. 140 Death Knight Legion Commander
> Lv. 148 Manticore Lord
findings.source:
[Lv.130 라이칸스로프 챔피언]

[Lv.140 데스나이트 군단장]

[Lv.148 만티코어 로드]

findings.current: Was it because of the martial prowess I’d shown, or my **[Intimidation]**?
findings.defect: The draft encloses a UI attribute in square brackets despite the packet's formatting rule.
findings.rationale: Intimidation is the established attribute name, but UI terms must not retain enclosing square brackets.
findings.replacement: Was it because of the martial prowess I’d shown, or my Intimidation?

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it reverses one encounter beat, changes who is being addressed near the end, and loses several tactical and character cues.
